questions.prompt: The soldiers marched across the river toward the enemy camp.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs trāns flūmen ad castra hostium contendērunt.

questions.prompt: On account of the storm we remained within the walls.
questions.answer: Propter tempestātem intrā mūrōs mānsimus.

questions.prompt: Before dawn the merchants set out toward Rome.
questions.answer: Ante lūcem mercātōrēs Rōmam versus profectī sunt.

questions.prompt: The farmer, worn out by the heat, sat near the spring.
questions.answer: Agricola, aestū cōnfectus, prope fontem sēdit.

questions.prompt: Through the whole night the watchmen guarded the gates against thieves.
questions.answer: Per tōtam noctem vigilēs portās contrā fūrēs custōdiēbant.

questions.prompt: Beyond the mountains, below the citadel, a wealthy king ruled.
questions.answer: Ultrā montēs, īnfrā arcem, rēx opulentus dominābātur.

questions.prompt: After the battle the general led his troops around the city.
questions.answer: Post proelium dux cōpiās circum urbem dūxit.

questions.prompt: The poet sang a song about love among his friends.
questions.answer: Poēta apud amīcōs canticum dē amōre cecinit.

questions.prompt: Near the temple, before the altar, the priest sacrificed a white bull.
questions.answer: Jūxtā templum, ante āram, sacerdōs candidum taurum immolāvit.

questions.prompt: The maiden fled beyond the fields, past the river, toward the woods.
questions.answer: Virgō ultrā agrōs, praeter flūmen, ad silvās fūgit.

questions.prompt: On account of his wounds the leader lay beneath a tree.
questions.answer: Ob vulnera dux subter arborem jacēbat.

questions.prompt: The messenger ran through the forest even to the walls of the city.
questions.answer: Nūntius per silvam ūsque ad mūrōs urbis cucurrit.

questions.prompt: Against so many enemies the small band fought within the camp.
questions.answer: Adversus tot hostēs parva manus intrā castra pugnāvit.

questions.prompt: Behind the hill, on this side of the stream, the horsemen hid themselves.
questions.answer: Pōne collem, cis rīvum, equitēs sē occultāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The sailors, wearied by the sea, steered their ship past the rocks.
questions.answer: Nautae, marī fessī, nāvem praeter saxa dīrēxērunt.

questions.prompt: About a thousand men gathered around the temple.
questions.answer: Circiter mīlle virī circā templum convēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The army, after the victory, marched even to the sea.
questions.answer: Exercitus, post victōriam, ūsque ad mare contendit.

questions.prompt: Between the two rivers, on this side of the mountains, they founded a town.
questions.answer: Inter duo flūmina, citrā montēs, oppidum condidērunt.

questions.prompt: The power lay in the hands of a cruel tyrant.
questions.answer: Potestās penes crūdēlem tyrannum erat.

questions.prompt: Toward the citizens the consul showed great kindness.
questions.answer: Ergā cīvēs cōnsul magnam benignitātem praestitit.

questions.prompt: Outside the gates, above the plain, an eagle flew.
questions.answer: Extrā portās, suprā campum, aquila volāvit.

questions.prompt: The old man walked toward the forum, near his son.
questions.answer: Senex ad forum, apud fīlium, ambulābat.

questions.prompt: Over the walls and beyond the towers the flames rose.
questions.answer: Super mūrōs et ultrā turrēs flammae surrēxērunt.

questions.prompt: According to the law, the citizens gathered before the temple.
questions.answer: Secundum lēgem cīvēs ante templum convēnērunt.
